title: Conditional Diffusion Models for Amortized Bayesian System Identification
abstract: arXiv:2611.20666v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative diffusion models rapidly solve Bayesian inverse problems, such as image restoration and inpainting, with a single trained model and without retraining for each new observation or task. Bayesian system identification, which typically involves inferring the hidden states and parameters of a dynamical system from measurements, poses a closely related inverse problem. Yet it is often addressed with computationally heavy Monte Carlo methods that must be rerun for every new measurement record. Moreover, these methods are restricted to a single inference task, and their cost grows with the state dimension and the record length. To alleviate these restrictions, we interpret Bayesian system identification in hiddem Markov models (HMMs) as a general Bayesian inverse problem, taking advantage of conditional diffusion models. translated_title: 面向摊销式贝叶斯系统辨识的条件扩散模型
translated_abstract: 生成扩散模型能够利用单个训练好的模型快速求解贝叶斯逆问题（如图像修复与图像修补），而无需针对每个新观测或新任务进行重新训练。贝叶斯系统辨识通常涉及从测量数据中推断动态系统的隐藏状态与参数，构成了一个密切相关的逆问题。然而，该问题通常采用计算量庞大的蒙特卡洛方法来解决，且这些方法必须针对每条新的测量记录重新运行。此外，这些方法仅限于单一推断任务，其计算成本还会随状态维度和记录长度的增加而增长。为缓解这些限制，我们将隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）中的贝叶斯系统辨识解释为一个一般的贝叶斯逆问题，并借助条件扩散模型的优势。具体而言，一个基于Transformer的扩散模型在模拟轨迹的短片段上仅需训练一次，即……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文将隐马尔可夫模型中的贝叶斯系统辨识视为一般贝叶斯逆问题，利用基于Transformer的条件扩散模型实现一次训练、多次摊销式推断，从而避免了传统蒙特卡洛方法对每条新测量记录重复计算的高昂成本。
en_tdlr: This paper casts Bayesian system identification in hidden Markov models as a general Bayesian inverse problem and leverages a transformer-based conditional diffusion model to achieve amortized inference with a single trained model, avoiding the costly re-running of Monte Carlo methods for each new measurement record.
